visual.general_description: Black-and-white flowchart of the study-selection steps for the registry analysis.
visual.detailed_description: White background with rectangular boxes joined by thin black lines with arrowheads and no colour. Along the top are two boxes: at left "Unpublished deaths shared by collaborators (n = 188)" and at centre "Potentially eligible studies identified by database search (n = 1159)". A central column runs downward through "Studies for full-text screening (n = 334)", "Included studies (n = 109)", "18 studies contributed data for 80 deaths", "RSV GOLD registry" and "Deaths included (n = 231)". To the right of the first split is "Excluded after title and abstract screening (n = 825)". A larger box to the right of the second split reads "Excluded after full-text screening (n = 225)" followed by a printed list of reasons with counts: 81 no mortality, 34 no nosocomial infection, 31 aged older than 5 years, 17 no RSV infection, 17 non-clinical studies, 14 review, 14 no full-text available, 7 death before 1995, 4 no author contact details available, 3 background article, 2 no RSV lab confirmation, 1 Spanish language. A thin line runs down the left side from the unpublished-deaths box and turns right into the RSV GOLD registry box. A box to the right of the registry box reads "Deaths excluded after assessment of data quality (n = 37)". A printed line at the bottom reads "Abbreviations: RSV, respiratory syncytial virus."

visual.general_description: Grouped bar chart of the proportion of patients dying by age band for LMIC, UMIC and HIC.
visual.detailed_description: Grouped vertical bar chart on a white background with light grey horizontal gridlines. The y axis is titled "Proportion of patients dying" with percentage ticks 0% to 45% in steps of 5%. The x axis is titled "Age at RSV-related death (months)" with eighteen age bands printed at an angle: <1, 1-3, 4-6, 7-9, 10-12, 13-15, 16-18, 19-21, 22-24, 25-27, 28-30, 31-33, 34-36, 37-39, 40-42, 52-54, 55-57 and 58-59. A legend at the bottom lists LMIC (n=32) in blue, UMIC (n=76) in orange and HIC (n=123) in grey. In the first band (<1) the blue bar is much taller than the orange and grey bars. In the 1-3 band no blue bar is drawn and the orange bar is taller than the grey bar, both being tall relative to most other bands. In the 4-6 band the orange bar is tallest, followed by the grey bar, with a shorter blue bar. The three series are of similar height in the 7-9 band. From 10-12 onward the bars are short, with no bar for some groups in many bands; grey bars extend across more of the later bands than orange or blue, and only an orange bar is drawn in each of the last two bands. No numeric data labels are printed above the bars.
